title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Credit for Direct Payments Above the Approved Installments
content:
Money a debtor has already paid on a cancelled repayment plan above the approved installments is credited against the reinstatement deposit on that debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery**.

**The excess.** The excess is the total of the direct payments received on the debt less the number of those payments multiplied by the installment approved for the cancelled plan (the approved amount on the latest repayment plan decision), and never below zero.

**The credit.**

- When there is an excess and the debt notice is within the waiver window, the whole excess is credited.
- When there is an excess and the notice is older than the waiver window, 50 percent of that excess (the late-credit percentage), rounded to the cent, is credited.
- When there is no excess, nothing is credited.

The credit is subtracted from the deposit once the deposit percentage has been applied; the outcome is never below zero and is rounded to the cent at the end.

**The waiver window**, in calendar days from the notice date to the day of the payment:

| Debt type | Waiver window (calendar days after the notice) |
|---|---|
| Education Overpayment (Chapters 30, 35 and 1606) | 180 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Housing and Books Overpayment | 180 |
| Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment | 180 |
| Disability Compensation Overpayment | 180 |
| Veterans Pension Overpayment | 180 |
| Home Loan Guaranty Debt | 365 |

## Ledger examples (hypothetical)

| Direct payments on the debt | Approved installment | Excess | Notice age | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3 payments totalling 300.00 USD | 87.40 USD | 300.00 less 262.20, that is 37.80 USD | 150 days, Education type | 37.80 USD |
| Same | Same | 37.80 USD | 200 days, Education type | 50 percent of 37.80, that is 18.90 USD |
| 2 payments totalling 150.00 USD | 75.00 USD | None | Any | Nothing |
